name: Webform Fields Chart
description: Render a Webform's fields/logic as a Mermaid chart.
project_description:
The Webform Fields Chart module generates Mermaid charts from the fields in a Drupal webform, enabling the visualisation of dependencies and conditional relationships between webform elements.

 Features 
 Outputs Mermaid charts that include Webform pages, fields, conditions.

 Usage 
 1. Go to Webforms:

 - Navigate to Structure > Webforms.

 2. View Chart:

 - Go to the specific webform's page by clicking on it in the list.

 - Click on the Chart tab to view the Mermaid chart of the webform.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 - Webform 

- Webform Conditions
